California signs SB 1350, integrating green hydrogen into the energy grid to solve storage gaps.

The bill qualifies green hydrogen as a renewable source, providing financial incentives to stabilize the grid when solar and wind are unavailable.

California's SB 1350 incentivizes green hydrogen production, allowing utilities to store excess renewable energy for use during peak demand or low-generation periods.
